title: Steam

{{Infobox map |name=Steam |year=2024 |image=Districtmini.jpg |creator={{player|alice|flag=se}} |gametype=4on4 |size=large |download=https://maps.quakeworld.nu/all/steam.bsp |loc=https://maps.quakeworld.nu/locs/steam.loc }} '''Steam''' is a 4on4 TDM map by {{player|alice|flag=se}}. The overall layout of the map consist of 2 opposing sides with an open street inbetween the sides, each side hold a key armor and a [[Rocket Launcher]]. Beneath this central street there is a sewer path where [[Lightning Gun]] is placed. The map aim to have a minimalistic aesthetic look with clean and simplified textures, as well trying to have a layout without unnecessary details. The plain texture set is supposed to assist with easy navigation, where [[Red Armor]] and [[Yellow Armor]] areas are distinctly colorized red and yellow.
